answer: Sybil Shield. 1) Each new identity proposes a unique claim. 2) Existing identities, acting as the reef, audit these claims, verifying uniqueness and legitimacy. 3) A claim is accepted only if it receives at least 10 distinct supporting claims from established identities. The zenith of accepted claims for N identities is N(N-1)/2. The explicit cost is $5 per verified claim, totaling $5 N(N-1)/2 for N identities.
